summary: A parent, Anna, has moved to Finland from England and is seeking full-time daycare options to balance their job and childcare for their three-year-old daughter. They are unfamiliar with the local system and ask for clarification on different daycare types available in Espoo. The advisor, Susan, explains that there are municipal, private family daycare, and open playground groups. The parent confirms they are looking for full-time care and asks for more details on the differences between these options. The advisor agrees to provide further information on the various daycare types and their distinctions.
